name: Footage card, side text
what: A dark scene dissolves into a warm light one while a tall card with your footage zooms down from big, dips and settles in the middle; then a bold orange text comes out on each side of it, letter by letter - the left one from behind the card, the right one from the edge of the frame.
use_for: vertical clip in a landscape video
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f17-f26 the dark scene dissolves into the light one while the card zooms down from x1.4, dips to x0.89 at f21 and settles at x1; f27-f40 the left text slides out letter by letter from behind the card (each letter 0.8 f after the one before, decelerating); f31-f47 the right text slides in letter by letter from the right edge; then it holds while the footage plays

tracks.name: dissolve
tracks.what: the dark scene dissolves into the light one

tracks.name: card
tracks.what: zooms down from x1.4, dips to x0.89 and settles; fades in

tracks.name: left text
tracks.what: slides out from behind the card, letter by letter

tracks.name: right text
tracks.what: slides in from the right edge, letter by letter

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: everything still (the footage keeps playing, the film grain moves)
